text:
Jamal Khan: incident-bot: Pager — hf-model-fetch errors observed for model downloads from Hugging Face registry, starting ~2045678910. 429s and occasional 5xx when pulling artifacts. Affecting cold starts on several host pools.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2045678910 (severity: P2) — third-party hosting rate limit.

Maria Ortiz: seeing steady 429s with Retry-After headers (3-10s). Failed fetches causing model server cold starts to spike error rate and latency for user-facing requests.

Alex Chen: confirming deploys — prewarmers are failing to pull model blobs. App-layer is returning 502s for generator routes.

Li Wei: quick telemetry: error rate on /generate up 5x, median latency from 120ms -> 900ms on cold requests. Customers in EU region hit hardest.

Jamal Khan: mitigation plan: 1) throttle internal fetch retries with exponential backoff + jitter; 2) fallback to cached quantized variant (if available); 3) route new requests to warmed instances using cached KV; 4) notify customers + set status page.

support-bot: Customer impact: 3 paying tenants reported increased 502s, multiple p99 latency alerts. No data exfiltration risk.

Alex Chen: rolling an emergency config to add `HF_DOWNLOAD_RETRY_BASE=2s` and max_retries=3, and enabling Prefetch-Fallback header.

Maria Ortiz: starting staged rollout to EU host pool now. Monitoring for reduced 429s.

sre-bot: oncall page: @oncall Jamal Khan -> please coordinate with infra to increase local cache TTLs to 1h and enable mirror pull if available.

Jamal Khan: @oncall acknowledged. Opening HF support ticket and escalation. Drafting message to HF: "We are observing 429s with Retry-After for model artifacts across multiple regions. Requesting rate-limit increase or guidance on retry windows. Incidents impacting production cold starts."

Alex Chen: temp mitigation: enable cached-artifact fallback in runtime config. Patch applied to 30% of nodes.

Maria Ortiz: logs show reduction in fetch failures on patched nodes. Rate of 429s on patched nodes dropped ~70%.

Jamal Khan: initiating customer comms: roadmap — short note on status page and targeted email to affected customers.

incident-bot: HF ticket created: HF-987654. HF responded: investigating rate-limiter misconfiguration; suggested 10s backoff and use of their mirror endpoint.

Li Wei: action: switch mirror endpoint for artifacts in EU pool, flipover in 5 minutes.

Alex Chen: mirror flip started. Adding exponential backoff and 30-60s cache priming for warmed hosts.

support-bot: asked CS to prepare outbound: two customers impacted (acme-inc, beta-labs); include workaround to toggle region fallback.

Jamal Khan: handoff to night oncall @Alex Chen at 2045679500. Summary for handoff:
- root cause: upstream HF rate limiting/cascade across artifact CDN
- mitigation: exponential retries with jitter, fallback to cached/quantized artifacts, mirror endpoint for EU, increased cache TTL
- customer impact: elevated 502/latency for EU tenants, 2 paying customers reported outages. No data loss.
- next steps: monitor HF ticket HF-987654, confirm HF mirror stability, consider pre-warming critical models during high-traffic windows, evaluate long-term mirrors or self-host for critical customers.

Alex Chen: acknowledged handoff. I'll own night watch and escalate to HF account team if HF responses lag.

oncall: closing handoff. If anything regresses ping #incidents and page.

Jamal Khan: closing thread — will update incident timeline tomorrow with postmortem notes.
